# live_voidable (Hex)

> HEEx function components for Voidable UI web components in Phoenix LiveView. Each renders the matching `<void-*>` element of the npm package `@voidable/ui`; the client half is `@voidable/ui-liveview`.

## Setup

```elixir
use VoidableUI   # imports VoidableUI.Components
```

Load `@voidable/ui`, `@voidable/theme` and `@voidable/ui-liveview` (`VoidHooks`, `VoidDOM`) in the asset pipeline. Render `<VoidableUI.Dev.warnings />` in the root layout after the app script for development warnings (`config :live_voidable, dev_warnings: false | true | :throw`).

## API

Components (`VoidableUI.Components`; name is the tag without `void-`, dashes as underscores):

<.badge> <.button> <.divider> <.spinner> <.skeleton> <.status_dot> <.switch> <.avatar> <.alert> <.tag> <.progress> <.panel> <.input> <.textarea> <.select> <.checkbox> <.radio> <.radio_group> <.field> <.option> <.multiselect> <.dialog> <.tabs> <.accordion> <.accordion_item> <.breadcrumbs> <.list> <.list_item> <.toast> <.toast_container> <.stepper> <.drawer> <.card> <.popover> <.tooltip> <.banner> <.scroll_area> <.table> <.pagination> <.error_fallback> <.checkbox_group> <.combobox> <.slider> <.file_upload> <.nav_bar> <.hamburger> <.compose_input> <.sidebar> <.dropdown_menu> <.dropdown_menu_item> <.toggle> <.toggle_group> <.segmented_control> <.segmented_control_item> <.stat> <.indicator> <.menu> <.menu_item> <.menu_group> <.carousel> <.carousel_previous> <.carousel_next> <.calendar> <.date_picker> <.number_input> <.collapsible> <.editable> <.hover_card> <.pin_input> <.tags_input> <.nav_menu> <.nav_menu_item> <.color_picker> <.action_input> <.bar_chart> <.line_chart> <.donut_chart> <.gauge>

Charts take their data from assigns: `<.bar_chart data={@sales} aria_label="Sales" />`. The data is encoded as the JSON `data` attribute (`zones` too on a gauge), so the first static render already draws the chart with no hook and no `id`; each chart carries a visually hidden data table, and `show_table` shows it.

- Components with explicit parts (dialog, drawer, popover, hover_card, dropdown_menu, tooltip, tabs, card, alert, accordion_item) take the parts as plain tags inside: `<.dialog id="confirm" open={@open}><void-dialog-title>Delete</void-dialog-title></.dialog>`.
- Events: LiveView's own bindings first (`phx-click`, `phx-change`, `phx-submit`). Opt in to a Voidable event with `events={true}` or `events={["void-close"]}`: it arrives as `handle_event("void-close", %{"id" => _, "name" => _, "detail" => _}, socket)`.
- Booleans are present or absent; what is drawn by default is turned off with `hide_*` (`hide_close`, `hide_border`).
- `VoidableUI.Dev.warnings/1`, `VoidableUI.Dev.url/0`, `VoidableUI.Dev.mode/0`.

## Full reference

Every `<void-*>` element (parts, attributes with allowed values, events with `detail`, examples) is in the npm package: `@voidable/ui/reference.md` (`node_modules/@voidable/ui/dist/reference.md`), summarised in `@voidable/ui/llms.txt`; adapter notes in `@voidable/ui-liveview/llms.txt`. Online: https://voidable.dev/llms.txt. Offline per element: `voidable ref <tag>`.
